disclaimer: Consolidated Phase 0 finding ledger (P0.7C). Derived from offline evidence, P0.6C human acceptance, P0.6D model-identity closure, P0.7A L-01, and P0.7B PydanticAI stress lane. NOT live provider semantic evidence. Proposed findings remain proposed until explicit KJ acceptance.

findings.expected_behavior: Framework-normalized usage must be distinguishable from provider-reported usage in the shared result contract.
findings.observed_behavior: results._usage_block hardcoded provenance=reported for all present usage, so LangChain framework-normalized usage_metadata was indistinguishable from provider-reported usage.
findings.reproduction_command: cd research/runtime-audit/harness && uv run pytest tests/test_usage_provenance.py -q
findings.semantic_impact: False equivalence between framework and provider usage provenance in cross-lane comparison.
findings.contract_implication: Additive usage.source field and provenance vocabulary; LangChain usage tagged framework_native.
findings.follow_up_experiment: Live lane comparison: confirm provider-reported vs framework-normalized usage source tags under real responses.
findings.kj_decision: Accepted F1 (2026-07-13, KJ): contract-level false equivalence.

findings.expected_behavior: Non-OpenAI cache and reasoning token fields must survive into the shared result summary without OpenAI-shaped coupling.
findings.observed_behavior: results._usage_block read only OpenAI-nested cache/reasoning paths; Anthropic cache_creation/cache_read and LangChain input_token_details tokens were dropped to null in the result summary.
findings.reproduction_command: cd research/runtime-audit/harness && uv run pytest tests/test_usage_provenance.py -q
findings.semantic_impact: Result-level data loss for supported non-OpenAI usage fields; OpenAI vendor-shape coupling in shared contract.
findings.contract_implication: Neutral usage extraction per lane; cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens added to result.usage.
findings.follow_up_experiment: Live Anthropic and LangChain USAGE-001 runs to confirm cache split preservation.
findings.kj_decision: Accepted F1 (2026-07-13, KJ): contract-level provider-shape coupling and result-level data loss.

findings.expected_behavior: Native provider/framework terminal states must be queryable at the result level without collapsing transcript detail.
findings.observed_behavior: Native terminal states (requires_action, incomplete, refusal, stop_reason, finish_reason) were preserved only in the transcript and collapsed to PASS/PASS_WITH_EXTENSION at the result level.
findings.reproduction_command: cd research/runtime-audit/harness && uv run pytest tests/test_terminal_state.py -q
findings.semantic_impact: Capability-shaping: Phase 1A needs queryable native terminal vocabulary at result level.
findings.follow_up_experiment: Live Gemini TOOL-001 requires_action and Anthropic refusal terminal states.
findings.kj_decision: Accepted F2 (2026-07-13, KJ): carry to Phase 1A.

findings.expected_behavior: Provider-vs-framework and reported-vs-estimated distinctions must use a centrally-owned provenance vocabulary.
findings.observed_behavior: No central provenance vocabulary existed; distinctions were expressed only by scattered signals.
findings.semantic_impact: Capability-shaping: cross-lane comparison and result records need consistent provenance tags.
findings.contract_implication: Central provenance vocabulary (nine terms) in provenance.py and protocol-neutrality matrix.
findings.kj_decision: Accepted F2 (2026-07-13, KJ): carry to Phase 1A.

findings.expected_behavior: Requested model and provider-returned model must be separate first-class fields with auditable provenance.
findings.observed_behavior: probe-response.model held requested model only; served model was preserved only in raw until P0.6D added observed_model_identity on results.
findings.reproduction_command: cd research/runtime-audit/harness && uv run pytest tests/test_model_identity.py -q
findings.semantic_impact: Implementation note closed offline; real alias/routing/snapshot behavior remains unverified_until_live.
findings.contract_implication: Additive result.observed_model_identity with requested_model, observed_returned_model, source, raw_ref, model_identity_match.
findings.follow_up_experiment: Live runs comparing requested vs returned model across native and framework lanes.
findings.kj_decision: Accepted F3 (2026-07-13, KJ); closed offline in P0.6D.

findings.expected_behavior: SDK-only lane should exercise the complete litellm.completion(tools=...) path without proxy-server dependencies.
findings.observed_behavior: litellm.completion(tools=...) imports proxy MCP utilities requiring FastAPI, absent by design in the SDK-only isolated probe. TOOL-001 uses partial path: get_optional_params request transform + ModelResponse injection.
findings.reproduction_command: cd research/runtime-audit/probes/litellm-sdk && uv run pytest tests/ -q -k tool
findings.semantic_impact: Capability-shaping: SDK-only tool semantics partially offline; no shared contract loss or false provenance observed.
findings.contract_implication: No contract change required; live completion(tools=...) path and provider adapter translation remain unverified_until_live.
findings.follow_up_experiment: Live LiteLLM SDK TOOL-001 with direct provider credential (not Proxy Server); or accept partial offline path with documented limitation.

observations.title: FunctionModel primary offline seam
observations.summary: Offline evidence uses FunctionModel exclusively; TestModel excluded because it auto-synthesizes schema-valid output and hides framework behavior.
observations.next_action: None offline; live provider model would use vendor SDK not present in slim install.

observations.title: ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False before Agent execution
observations.summary: Real provider model requests are fail-closed; FunctionModel is exempt. Combined with network tripwire (loopback-only).
observations.next_action: Retain policy for any future live PydanticAI lane extension.

observations.title: NativeOutput explicitly selected (not silent fallback)
observations.summary: STR-001 exercises NativeOutput via synthetic model profile (output_mode=native); valid JSON alone is not treated as native-structured proof.
observations.next_action: Live validation of provider structured-output adherence unverified_until_live.

observations.title: Deferred tool stop-the-world semantics
observations.summary: Approval-required tool yields DeferredToolRequests terminal; tool body never executes; mapped to requires_action category, not failure.

observations.title: RunUsage vs RequestUsage kept distinct
observations.summary: Agent run aggregate is framework_native; per-turn ModelResponse usage is fixture_expected offline; not merged without provenance.

observations.title: No N-01..N-05 regression across six lanes
observations.summary: P0.7B stress lane does not reintroduce usage provenance false-equivalence, usage field loss, terminal collapse, missing provenance vocabulary, or model identity conflation.

observations.title: Instrumentation and Gateway absent
observations.summary: Logfire/OpenTelemetry SDK/exporter not installed; instrumentation never enabled; no Gateway client; slim install cannot construct real provider models.
observations.next_action: Retain exclusion of Gateway/Logfire from Phase 0 native lane evidence.
